task: Binary Sentinel-1 SAR oil slick tile classification
confidence: softmax(logits, dim=1)[:, 1] — probability of the oil-slick class
notes: config.json from the HF repo lists num_channels=1 and single-value normalization; the published conv1 weights are (64, 3, 7, 7), so the network is 3-channel. ImageNet 3-channel normalization is the only variant that yields a discriminative response and is used here.

The HF repo's inference.py calls torch.load(model.pth).eval() directly, which fails because model.pth is a state_dict, not a pickled module. ORICEAN reconstructs torchvision.resnet50 and loads the stripped state_dict.
limitations: Positive predictions identify candidate SAR tiles rather than exact pixel-level slick boundaries
GEE Sentinel-1 production preprocessing must be validated against the training dataset representation
